top_choice_rationale: Base editing for Liu alone is the cleanest chemical achievement on the slate: an engineered deaminase on a programmable scaffold converts a base without a double-strand break, and the adenine editor needed an evolved enzyme for a substrate no natural enzyme accepts. It is new, widely reproduced, already used in patients, and the attribution is the least contested (one name). Pairings that add Crews and Deshaies (P001) or Buchwald and Hartwig (P004) keep Liu but dilute the prize or raise overlap with the 2010 prize; degraders without Liu (P002), zeolites (P003) and condensates (P005) follow, and no award is last.
